description: Create comprehensive DataTable component for admin list pages, eliminating the largest source of duplication (~2,400 lines). Convert contacts, inquiries, and complaints pages to use the new component. This is the most complex feature with the highest impact.
steps: Create types/admin-table.ts with Column<T> and DataTableProps<T> interfaces

Create components/admin/data-table.tsx with support for: configurable columns, desktop table grid layout, mobile card view via mobileCardRenderer prop, loading state, empty state with icon and message
Define column configurations for Contacts page: contact info, subject, type, status, date, actions columns with appropriate render functions
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/contacts/page.tsx to use <DataTable> component, replacing both desktop table header/rows and mobile card JSX (~200 lines removed)
Define column configurations for Inquiries page: company, contact, project types, budget, status, date, actions
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/inquiries/page.tsx to use <DataTable> component (~250 lines removed)
Define column configurations for Complaints page: user, subject, category, proof, priority, status, date, actions
Update app/admin/(dashboard)/complaints/page.tsx to use <DataTable> component (~200 lines removed)
Test DataTable component responsive behavior on desktop and mobile viewports
Verify all links, badges, and icons render correctly in both layouts
acceptance_criteria: DataTable component accepts generic type T and Column<T>[] configuration
Contacts, inquiries, and complaints admin pages use <DataTable> component
Desktop view shows proper table grid with all columns
Mobile view shows cards via mobileCardRenderer
Loading and empty states display correctly
All status badges, priority badges, and action links work as before
Responsive test: Both desktop and mobile viewports render correctly
verification: Desktop test: Visit localhost:3000/admin/contacts in full browser window, verify table displays with all columns (Contact, Subject, Type, Status, Date, Actions)
Mobile test: Resize to mobile viewport or use dev tools, verify cards display with all information
Desktop test: Visit localhost:3000/admin/inquiries, verify table with Company, Contact, Type, Budget, Status, Date, Actions columns
Mobile test: Same page in mobile viewport, verify inquiry cards
Desktop test: Visit localhost:3000/admin/complaints, verify table
Mobile test: Complaints page in mobile viewport
Click test: Click 'View' link on contacts page, verify it navigates to detail page
Empty state test: If possible, view a page with no data and verify empty message displays
